evals.prompt: Audit the skills in this repository and tell me if everything is set up correctly.
evals.expected_output: A structured audit report for the repository root. It counts every SKILL.md outside tests/, runs all seven checks, and lists each finding with its file. The fixtures under tests/ are not reported.

assertions.text: Report contains a Skills Audit header or section title
Report states how many SKILL.md files were scanned, and the number matches the SKILL.md files outside tests/
Report states the number of errors and the number of warnings
Report covers all 7 check categories (name alignment, frontmatter fields, delimiters, stale refs, broken links, body completeness, body length)
Report does not list any finding from tests/auditing/dirty-test-repo

evals.prompt: Audit the skills repo at tests/auditing/dirty-test-repo and report any issues you find.
evals.expected_output: A structured audit report identifying: 1 name/folder mismatch error (wrong-name folder vs totally-wrong name), 1 missing description error (no-description), 2 stale skill reference warnings (analyzing-data, generating-report), 1 broken link warning (references/nonexistent.md), and an incomplete-body warning for each of the four fixtures (each has fewer than 5 lines after the frontmatter).

assertions.text: Report identifies the name/folder mismatch in capabilities/wrong-name (name: totally-wrong vs folder: wrong-name)
Report identifies missing description in patterns/no-description
Report identifies stale reference to analyzing-data
Report identifies stale reference to generating-report
Report identifies broken link to references/nonexistent.md
Report flags the fixtures as incomplete skill bodies (fewer than 5 lines of content)
Report distinguishes errors from warnings (structural issues vs references/links)

evals.prompt: Check if everything in my skills folder is set up correctly. It's the repo I'm in.
evals.expected_output: A structured audit report for the repository root. Tests that the skill triggers from informal phrasing.

assertions.text: Report has structured audit format (not just a casual conversational response)
Report states the number of errors and the number of warnings
Report covers multiple check categories (not just one)
